tables.name: sr_local_id_allocator
columns: next_value INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(next_value BETWEEN 1 AND 99999999)
rules: allocation occurs inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE UnitOfWork that inserts the Service Request
formatted identity is LSR- followed by exactly eight zero-padded decimal digits
after successful allocation next_value increments exactly once
rolled-back creation rolls allocator increment back with it
an allocated identifier committed to any SR is never reassigned even if future separately authorized deletion existed
value exhaustion blocks creation with SR_LOCAL_ID_EXHAUSTED; wrap/reuse is forbidden
